disposition_reason: Annex Part II sets arsenic, lead and cadmium MLs for 'Pasta de cacao' and for chocolates/cocoa products with less than / more than 40% cacao (As 0,50/0,20/0,40; Pb 0,50/0,20/0,40; Cd 0,30/0,20/0,30 mg/kg). Mercury and tin tables do not name cocoa.
disposition_locator: Annex Part II: Arsénico table (PDF p. 6), Plomo table (p. 8), Cadmio table (p. 10); Annex 1.5-1.6, 2.7; Art. 6

study.material_scope: cocoa paste; chocolates and cocoa products by % cacao
study.basis: product as offered to the consumer (Annex 1.6); edible part

Products at exactly 40% cacao fall between the '< 40 %' and '> 40 %' classes as written.
Cocoa powder, cocoa butter and cocoa beans are not named; whether 'productos de cacao' captures cocoa powder is not defined in the text.
